content.short: BlockWallet is a self-custodial Web3 wallet that streamlines cross-chain use with strong security and a user-friendly experience.
content.description: BlockWallet is a self-custodial Web3 wallet built for privacy and security, giving you full control over your digital assets. Connect to your favorite DApps, configure custom networks with ease, and move across multiple chains using built-in swaps and bridges. View gas fees and buy cryptocurrencies directly in the wallet. For added security, link a hardware wallet for secure holding, staking, or sending crypto. It supports Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, BNB Chain, ZKsync, Base, Starknet, and Bitcoin.
content.meta: BlockWallet is a self-custodial Web3 wallet focused on privacy and security for complete control over your digital assets. Discover BlockWallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
